title: How the approved replay sample is organized

sections.title: Episode and step structure
sections.summary: Each replay is a completed two-agent episode. The approved sample contains 20 episodes and 3,039 environment steps, with both agents marked DONE at the end.
sections.why_it_matters: A replay is a time-ordered interaction, not a flat list of independent game positions.

sections.title: Initialization is separate from gameplay
sections.summary: Step 0 is an empty active initialization record for both agents. Step 1 contains each agent's 60-card deck action. Gameplay choices begin after that transition.
sections.why_it_matters: Deck initialization must not be mistaken for an ordinary legal-option decision.

sections.title: Actions are lag-aligned
sections.summary: The action recorded at step t answers the selection request shown in the same agent's preceding active record at step t-1, not the select object stored beside that action.
sections.why_it_matters: Training on same-row observation/action pairs would create incorrect supervision even though the JSON parses successfully.

sections.title: Transport integers are not action meaning
sections.summary: Recorded actions are integer lists while legal options are structured objects containing fields such as type, area, index, attackId or in-play position. The integer encoding varies by request family.
sections.why_it_matters: The loader must resolve each transport integer to the correct semantic option before using replay decisions for analysis or learning.

sections.title: The sample is useful but biased
sections.summary: The daily dataset is selected by episode ratings and capped. It is valuable for format discovery and elite-play hypotheses but is not an unbiased estimate of the hidden evaluation distribution.
sections.why_it_matters: Ideas learned from these episodes still require controlled engine evaluation against the frozen benchmark suite.

boundaries: Replay bodies remain private and are not served by the dashboard.
This structural audit does not claim that behavior-cloning supervision is ready.
No additional episode download or training is authorized by this learning record.
